score_semantics: Source-contract confidence only; not parcel-result or numeric elevation accuracy.

candidates.name: OS Open UPRN Technical Specification
verified_facts: OS Open UPRN contains the UPRN and position of each record held within AddressBase Premium
The product supports linking datasets by UPRN or address-point position
The point attributes include British National Grid coordinates and ETRS89 latitude and longitude
semantic_limits: A UPRN point represents an addressable location and is not a title or parcel polygon
A spatially nearby UPRN cannot prove the canonical shard row
Original UPRN, BNG coordinates, product version and source file hash must be retained

candidates.name: OS Open Linked Identifiers Technical Specification
verified_facts: The product provides authoritative relationships between UPRNs, USRNs and TOIDs
UPRNs are persistent identifiers for addressable locations and are not reused
A TopographicArea TOID can identify a building outline or road-surface feature in OS MasterMap
semantic_limits: A UPRN-to-TOID link is not an HM Land Registry title match
One identifier may have multiple relationships and every relation type must be evaluated
The relationship product version must be recorded with every candidate

candidates.name: OS Open Linked Identifiers Product Structure
verified_facts: Linked-identifier relationships are distributed as separate CSV packages
Each relationship package includes product-version information in JSON
BLPU_UPRN_TopographicArea_TOID is a defined relationship package
semantic_limits: The CSV relationship alone contains no HM Land Registry polygon geometry
A relationship from the wrong package or product version must be rejected
Identifier links are candidate evidence and cannot be silently promoted to parcel identity

candidates.name: OS Open TOID Technical Specification
verified_facts: A TOID is a persistent identifier for features represented in OS MasterMap products
OS Open TOID provides a generalised location for the identified feature
A TOID is not reassigned to a different feature during its lifecycle
semantic_limits: The open generalised TOID location is not the underlying MasterMap polygon
A TOID must not replace the exact HMLR INSPIRE polygon
Retired or changed features require version-aware handling

candidates.name: HM Land Registry INSPIRE Index Polygons
verified_facts: The dataset contains locations of registered freehold property in England and Wales
Each polygon has a Land Registry-INSPIRE ID related to a registered title
A polygon crossing a local-authority boundary can occur in both authority files
semantic_limits: The polygon is an indicative extent and not a legal boundary determination
The dataset is a freehold subset and does not cover every addressable interest
Final acceptance requires exact INSPIRE ID, geometry, dated snapshot and duplicate handling
